app.name: monkeyword
app.subtitle: Personal research assistant
app.offlineBody: The app will retry bundled fixtures. No network connection is used.

dashboard.title: See today’s priorities in one workspace
dashboard.body: Review search intent, rankings, backlinks, audit signals, and next actions using mock data.

onboarding.title: Explore the mock workspace in three minutes
onboarding.body: The app uses bundled fictional data only and does not connect to live services.
onboarding.step3: Turn coach advice into action candidates
onboarding.queued: Mock job added to the queue

keywords.title: Keyword candidates
keywords.body: Compare search volume, difficulty, and intent clusters.

ranks.title: Rank tracking
ranks.body: Inspect ranking changes and SERP features with the fixed seven-day fixture.

backlinks.title: Backlink analysis
backlinks.body: Review fictional referring links sorted by quality.

audit.title: Site audit
audit.body: Display Core Web Vitals and basic checks from mock data.

competitors.title: Competitor analysis
competitors.body: Compare fictional competitor domains and keyword gaps.

brief.title: Content brief
brief.body: Organize intent, outline, FAQ, and internal link candidates.

coach.title: AI Coach
coach.body: Review the next actions sorted by priority.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Phase 1 is locked to mock mode. Saved credentials are never shown again.
